technique_name: What are the major components of the Java programming language?
description: The major components of the Java programming language are the Java Virtual Machine (JVM), the Java Runtime Environment (JRE), the Java Platform, the Java Development Kit (JDK), and the Java Libraries. These components provide core components such as threading, garbage collection, memory management and reflection, as well as APIs such as the I/O package, networking, graphics, and more.
